questions.label: Where will the server run?
questions.help: Local stdio for Claude Desktop/Code, or an HTTP server for Docker/systemd.

questions.label: Bind host
questions.help: Interface the HTTP server binds to.

questions.label: Port
questions.help: TCP port for the HTTP server.

questions.label: Public base URL
questions.help: Public base URL of the deployed server, for example `https://mcp.example.com`. Required for OIDC. Also the fallback source of the MCP Apps domain when `app_domain` is unset.

questions.label: Bearer token
questions.help: Single shared bearer token; enables bearer auth unless `bearer_tokens_file` is set, which takes precedence.

questions.label: OIDC discovery URL
questions.help: OIDC discovery document URL, for example `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.

questions.label: OIDC client ID
questions.help: OIDC client identifier registered with the provider.

questions.label: OIDC client secret
questions.help: OIDC client secret registered with the provider.

questions.label: OIDC audience
questions.help: Expected `aud` claim; tokens issued for another audience are rejected.

questions.label: OIDC required scopes (CSV)
questions.help: Scopes a caller must present, space- or comma-separated. Defaults to `openid` in oidc-proxy mode.

questions.label: OIDC advertised scopes (CSV)
questions.help: Scopes advertised to MCP clients in protected-resource metadata, space- or comma-separated. Overrides the default `openid offline_access`; `oidc_required_scopes` is always added on top. Set this when the registered client is not permitted `offline_access`, or to have clients request extra claim scopes (such as `groups`) without also requiring them in every token.

questions.label: OIDC JWT signing key
questions.help: Optional signing key for issued JWTs. When unset it is derived from the client secret; set explicitly to keep tokens valid across a secret rotation. Generate: openssl rand -hex 32.

questions.label: Verify access token (not id token)
questions.help: Validate the access token instead of the id token.

questions.label: KV store URL (HTTP session persistence)
questions.help: Persistent-state backend URL: memory://, file:///path, redis://, dynamodb://, or mongodb://. Defaults to file:///data/state when unset.

questions.label: Event store URL (HTTP resumability)
questions.help: Legacy state-backend override, used by `build_event_store` and `build_kv_store` only when `kv_store_url` is unset. It then backs every namespace, not just HTTP resumability. Prefer `kv_store_url` for new deployments.

questions.label: Tasks Url
questions.help: Background-task (Docket) backend URL: `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `redis://` is durable and multi-process. When unset, a `redis://` `kv_store_url` is reused for tasks too; otherwise fastmcp's `memory://` default applies. Only meaningful when task-enabled tools exist. Applied via `configure_task_backend`.

questions.label: MCP Apps domain
questions.help: MCP Apps iframe domain, used for CSP sandboxing. Overrides the host derived from `base_url`.

questions.label: Tool allowlist (CSV)
questions.help: Comma-separated tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden. Leave empty to expose all tools. Mutually exclusive with the denylist.

questions.label: Tool denylist (CSV)
questions.help: Comma-separated tool names to hide from this instance. Mutually exclusive with the allowlist.

questions.label: Bearer tokens file (TOML)
questions.help: Path to a TOML file mapping bearer tokens to subjects; overrides the single-token `bearer_token` mode.

questions.label: Bearer default subject
questions.help: Subject assigned to the single-token bearer mode; ignored when `bearer_tokens_file` is set, since mapped mode carries per-token subjects.

questions.label: Server Name
questions.help: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

questions.label: Instructions Extra
questions.help: Operator context appended to the generated MCP instructions.

questions.label: Instructions
questions.help: Legacy: replaces the entire generated MCP instructions text (deprecated; prefer the _EXTRA variant).

questions.label: HTTP endpoint path
questions.help: Mount path for the MCP endpoint.

questions.label: Log level
questions.help: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.

questions.label: Rich logging
questions.help: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.

questions.label: Read Only
questions.help: When true, write-tagged tools (image generation, transforms, uploads) are hidden from clients. Set false to enable them.

questions.label: Scratch Dir
questions.help: Directory where generated images are saved. Created automatically on first use.

questions.label: Openai Api Key
questions.help: OpenAI API key. Enables the OpenAI provider (gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, dall-e-3) when set.

questions.label: Google Api Key
questions.help: Google API key. Enables the Gemini provider (gemini-3.1-flash-image and others) when set. Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.

questions.label: Sd Webui Host
questions.help: SD WebUI base URL (such as http://localhost:7860). Enables the SD WebUI provider when set. Compatible with AUTOMATIC1111, Forge, reForge, and Forge-neo.

questions.label: Sd Webui Model
questions.help: SD WebUI checkpoint name, used for model-aware preset detection (SD 1.5 / SDXL / Lightning) and checkpoint override. Unset uses the instance's current model.

questions.label: Default Provider
questions.help: Provider used when no keyword triggers auto-selection: auto, openai, gemini, sd_webui, or placeholder. auto picks the first configured provider.

questions.label: Transform Cache Size
questions.help: Maximum number of transformed image results (resize, crop, convert) kept in memory. Set 0 to disable caching.

questions.label: Paid Providers
questions.help: Comma-separated provider names that cost money; generate_image asks for confirmation (client elicitation) before using them. An empty value falls back to this default; to disable confirmation, set a value that names no provider (such as none).

questions.label: Styles Dir
questions.help: Directory for style preset files (Markdown with YAML front matter). Created automatically if it does not exist.

questions.label: Allow Local File Input
questions.help: Allow reading input images from local filesystem paths. Off by default: only URLs and uploads are accepted.

questions.label: Max Input Image Bytes
questions.help: Maximum accepted input image size in bytes.

questions.label: Fetch Timeout S
questions.help: HTTP timeout in seconds when fetching remote image URLs (fetch_image and URL inputs).

questions.label: Transfer Ttl Default S
questions.help: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

questions.label: Transfer Ttl Max S
questions.help: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

questions.label: Transfer Grace Ttl S
questions.help: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

questions.label: Transfer Lease S
questions.help: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

questions.label: Transfer Max Upload Bytes
questions.help: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.

guards.message: OIDC needs BASE_URL set. Leaving OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY unset derives the key from the client secret, so rotating that secret invalidates every issued token.
No provider is configured — the server will start but cannot generate images. Fill in at least one of: OpenAI API key, Google API key, or SD WebUI host.
